title: IN WHICH FIX DOES NOT SEEM TO UNDERSTAND IN THE LEAST WHAT IS SAID TO HIM
summary_hover: Aboard the steamer Rangoon, Aouda grows closer to Fogg while Detective Fix plots to delay Fogg's departure from Hong Kong.
summary_detail: The travellers are aboard the steamer Rangoon sailing from Calcutta to Hong Kong. Aouda becomes better acquainted with the politely eccentric Phileas Fogg, feeling deep gratitude for her rescue. Meanwhile, Detective Fix is secretly on board, agonizing over his failure to receive an arrest warrant. He reveals his presence to Passepartout, feigning ignorance of their recent adventures to gather information and plot a way to detain Fogg.
